oneSentenceStory: Review combined partner reward balances and transfer options using clear, jargon-free plain English.
customerSituation: The customer holds balances across three separate partner programmes and wants to view them together without complex terminology.
storyTension: Complex technical jargon and fragmented balances make it difficult to understand how points move between partner programmes.
customerResolution: A unified, jargon-free rewards overview clearly presents combined balances and straightforward portability options.
primaryOutcome: Effortless understanding of multi-partner reward balances and clear, jargon-free portability options.
